text: You again. What's up?
zh: 又是你。有啥事？

text: Yo, you better not go any farther.
zh: 喂，你最好别再往前走了。

text: Tis the path into the Rhoga swamp.
zh: 这可是通往罗加沼泽的路。

text:
A brutal beast is lurkin' 'round.
Go back to wherever ya came from.
zh:
有头凶残的野兽在附近游荡。
你从哪儿来就回哪儿去吧。

text: Who are you?
zh: 你是谁？

text: Why don't you leave the swamp?
zh: 你为什么不离开沼泽？

text: Which beast are you talking about?
zh: 你说的是什么野兽？

text: What do you eat around here?
zh: 你在这儿都吃些什么？

text: Do you still need something to eat?
zh: 你还需要吃的吗？

text: What can you teach me?
zh: 你能教我什么？

text: What do you know about the people in the swamp?
zh: 关于沼泽里的那些人，你知道些什么？

text: Do you know how to access the temple?
zh: 你知道怎么进入神殿吗？

text: Do you know where to get the heart of a warrior?
zh: 你知道去哪儿弄一颗战士之心吗？

text: Let's poison this heart.
zh: 我们来给这颗心下毒吧。

text: See you!
zh: 回见！

text: I am #:Bauric:#.
zh: 我是#:鲍里克:#。

text: I am a hunter in this godforsaken swamp for years now.
zh: 我在这片被神遗弃的沼泽里当了好些年猎人了。

text: I have my reasons.
zh: 我有我的理由。

text: A creature straight from the underworld.
zh: 一只直接从冥界爬出来的怪物。

text: If I were you, I would just turn around and never come back.
zh: 我要是你，就立刻转身走人，再也别回来。

text: Living as an outlaw near the swamp is not a lucrative job, you know. And Rair in the inn won't serve anyone without coins.
zh: 在沼泽边上当个法外之徒可赚不了几个钱，你懂的。旅店的莱尔又不肯招待没钱的人。

text: To be quite honest, there's only a handful of things to eat around here.
zh: 老实说，这一带能吃的东西没几样。

text: Talking about things to eat...
zh: 说到吃的……

text: I was poisoned a while ago during a hunt and had to rest for a few days. So, I haven't had something between my teeth for quite a while.
zh: 前阵子打猎时我中了毒，不得不歇了几天。所以我已经好久没吃过一口东西了。

text: You don't happen to have a stew or some meat?
zh: 你身上不会正好有炖菜或者肉吧？

text: Here, take this roasted meat.
zh: 给，这块烤肉拿去。

text: Here, take this Steak.
zh: 给，这块牛排拿去。

text: Here, take these Fried Frog Legs.
zh: 给，这份炸蛙腿拿去。

text: Here, take this stew.
zh: 给，这份炖菜拿去。

text: Here, take this Meat Sandwich.
zh: 给，这个肉三明治拿去。

text: Here, take this bread.
zh: 给，这块面包拿去。

text: Here, take Rair's Stew.
zh: 给，这份莱尔炖菜拿去。

text: Here, take this Special Sandwich.
zh: 给，这个特制三明治拿去。

text: I don't have something to share.
zh: 我没什么能分给你的。

text: Don't worry. I won't starve just yet.
zh: 别担心，我一时半会儿还饿不死。

text:
Thank you, man!
You just saved my life.
zh:
谢了，伙计！
你救了我一命。

text: I'll be eating that later today.
zh: 我今天晚些时候就吃。

text: I won't be able to pay you, to be honest.
zh: 老实说，我没钱付给你。

text: But if you want, I can show you a few things.
zh: 不过你要是愿意，我可以教你几手。

text: Sure man!
zh: 没问题，伙计！

text: I was out here for quite a while, so I had to find a way to handle the venomous creatures.
zh: 我在这儿待了很久，所以不得不想办法对付那些有毒的家伙。

text: You better stay away from them.
zh: 你最好离他们远点。

text: Those people perform unholy rituals and other reprehensible things.
zh: 那些人搞不洁的仪式，还干些别的见不得人的勾当。

text: Only the cult leader nearby knows how to break and apply the seal to the door.
zh: 只有附近的邪教头目知道怎么解开和施加门上的封印。

text: The mages of the academy might as well know how to break it, but they don't come here into the swamp.
zh: 学院的法师们也许也知道怎么解开，但他们不会来这片沼泽。

text:
A what?
Heart of a warrior?
zh:
一颗什么？
战士之心？

text:
What is that?
And what do you need it for?
zh:
那是什么玩意儿？
你要它干什么？

text: The cult needs a heart for their research.
zh: 邪教需要一颗心来做研究。

text: Forget it.
zh: 当我没说。

text: It's probably better this way.
zh: 这样也许更好。

text:
The cult?
You better not help them, got it?
zh:
邪教？
你最好别帮他们，听懂了吗？

text: But I've got an idea.
zh: 不过我有个主意。

text: How about you deliver them a heart, but we poison that to make it useless?
zh: 不如这样：你照样给他们送一颗心去，但我们先给它下毒，让它变成废物？

text: This way you can still get your reward and we prevent possible problems.
zh: 这样你照样能拿到报酬，我们也能防患于未然。

text: Just come to me if you want to poison the heart of a warrior.
zh: 想给战士之心下毒的话，来找我就行。

text: Good, this will only take a second.
zh: 好，马上就好。

text: Alright, this should do the trick.
zh: 行了，这样应该就成了。

text: Poison resistance (min. 8 VIT) [2 AP]#args:{"hint":"ui_dialogue_hint_skill_resistance_poison_30","only_once_on_difficulty": true}
zh: 毒素抗性（需体力8）[2 技能点]#args:{"hint":"ui_dialogue_hint_skill_resistance_poison_30","only_once_on_difficulty": true}

text: Craft Poison Bombs [150 Gold]
zh: 制作毒素炸弹 [150 金币]

text: That's all.
zh: 没别的事了。

text: See ya.
zh: 回见。

text: The trick is your breathing. Poison spreads faster if you exert yourself too much.
zh: 诀窍在于呼吸。你越是使劲，毒素扩散得越快。

text: Keep your breathing under control and you will suffer less damage.
zh: 控制好呼吸，你受的伤害就会更少。

text: As far as I know, the temple door was sealed by an old magical ritual.
zh: 据我所知，神殿的门是被一种古老的魔法仪式封住的。

text: Unless you get a spell on how to break the seal, you'll have to deal with the cult leader.
zh: 除非你搞到能破解封印的法术，否则你就得去跟那个邪教头目打交道。

text: Turns out, you can mix frogmen poison glands with firebombs.
zh: 原来蛙人的毒腺可以和火焰炸弹混在一起用。

text: The blast weakens because of the poison fluid, but it releases a toxic cloud on impact.
zh: 毒液会让爆炸的威力变弱，但炸弹落地时会释放出一团毒云。
